name: Marko Babić
bio:
Marko's journey into motorsport was somewhat unconventional. Growing up in Zagreb, he initially pursued a degree in graphic design, but a chance encounter with a local racing team ignited a passion for the high-octane world of motorsport. He quickly realized his design skills could be invaluable in marketing and promotion.

His approach to marketing is highly collaborative, believing that the best campaigns emerge from a deep understanding of the team's goals and the fans' desires. At Manthey Racing, he focuses on crafting engaging content that showcases the team's technical prowess and highlights the personalities behind the wheel. Marko's calm demeanor and creative problem-solving skills make him a valuable asset, especially during high-pressure race weekends.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Marko is of average height with a lean build and a friendly, approachable face.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with marketing ideas.
Has a habit of sketching logos and campaign concepts during team meetings.
Insists on listening to Croatian folk music while editing promotional videos.
